mixed_map.about: Which stock CPS data the cfw firmware uses, per radio model. sections: stock CPS tree node (schema/stock_*.json tree target) -> {label, model: state}. keys: table -> column -> {model: state}; Channel lists every stock channel column cfw does not model itself, other tables only columns that differ from their section. Missing = stored; a column missing from keys has its section's state. Edit states by hand or with tools/make_cfw_support.py --set, then run it (copies to web/schema) and make vectors.

states.stored: kept in the cfw codeplug, the firmware ignores it (GUI: 'not used by cfw yet' note, *)
states.n/a: this radio / its stock CPS has no such feature (hidden)
